thesis: The morning thesis still holds. The fiscal Q4 beat and outlook (gap 40.48 to 48.90 on 2026-11-11) support a stacked uptrend (44.815 > SMA20 41.95 > SMA50 38.12 > SMA200 28.73, RSI14 56.0), the balance sheet is clean (cash 332.7M vs debt 51.9M), and the news card shows no new negative event behind today's -4.8% move (47.09 to 44.81). The pullback the morning card waited for has happened, but it went deeper than planned: the morning zone 45.0-46.8 was crossed from the 46.10 open down to a 44.20 low. The entry is re-based to the technical card's 44.0-45.2 zone, just above the 43.15-43.52 post-gap support. The target is cut from 56.9 to the 50.06 52-week high (first resistance), because a breakout is less likely after two weak sessions in a risk-off tape. That gives an R/R of 3.2 at the 44.6 midpoint and about 2.75 at the 44.81 last price. Confidence is cut from 0.38 to 0.35 because the 42.9 stop is only about 0.6 ATR away (ATR 2.93) and AZTA is falling while healthcare (XLV) holds up. News items are RSS headlines only, and the 10-K filed 2026-11-19 has not been reviewed.
invalidation: Daily close below 42.9, under the post-gap lows of 43.15 and 43.52, which would fill the 11/11 earnings gap; a loss of 43.15 intraday on rising volume is an early warning.
